name: Ethereal Web
summary: Pale, glowing pastels, soft focus, thin serif or light sans type, translucent layers and air. It aims at a calm, dreamlike, weightless mood and reads as light rather than as object.

philosophy.core_thesis: Lightness is luxury: haze, glow and space make a quiet, weightless world.
design_principles: Set the ground in a pale gradient between 2 or 3 tints (for example #FDF7FF to #EAF4FF) with lightness above 92%.
Add soft blobs of colour 300px to 700px wide, blurred by 100px to 200px, at 30% to 50% opacity in pastel hues.
Set headings in a light serif or a thin sans at weight 200 to 300 and size 48px to 96px, with tracking of -0.01em to +0.04em.
Layer translucent panels: white at 40% to 60%, blur of 16px to 32px, a 1px white border at 60% and a radius of 24px to 40px.
Use a shadow of 0 20px 60px at 6% to 10% in a tinted colour and never a grey or black shadow above 12%.
Keep text colour in a soft slate (#4A4A5E) with contrast of at least 4.5:1; avoid pure black.
Animate slowly: fades and drifts of 8px to 24px over 800ms to 1500ms.

layout.grid_mechanics: A single airy column and wide hero; sections have 120px to 200px vertical gaps; panels float without alignment to a rigid grid.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 50% to 65% of the surface is empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32, 64 and 128px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred headings; short paragraphs centred or flush left in 480px to 560px measures.
layout.container_geometry: Pills and large radii of 24px to 40px; circles; no sharp corners.

font_pairings.note: A light, elegant serif with high contrast.
A soft serif with a gentle, warm voice.
A thin geometric sans for a quiet, modern voice.

hierarchy_rules: Use weights 300 for display and 400 for body.
Set labels in small caps or upper case at 11px to 12px with +0.12em.
Set italics for emphasis in the serif.

color.palette_structure: Pastel haze: lilac, sky, blush and pearl on white.
color.contrast_rules: Slate on pearl holds 8:1; mute holds at least 4.5:1; pastels fill shapes and never carry text.
color.surface_treatment: Pale gradients with blurred pastel blobs and a grain of 2% to 4%.
color.light_and_shadow: Soft and tinted: 0 20px 60px at 6% to 10%; light comes from above with no hard edge.

materiality.surface_simulation: Mist, silk and glass in soft light.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px white line at 60% on panels; no dark border.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Blur 16px to 32px; soft tinted shadow; one elevation level.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Thin 1.25px outline icons with round caps in slate; small stars and sparkles.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Soft-focus photography, clouds, pearl and glass objects, blurred colour fields.

motion.transition_physics: Slow and floating: elements fade up 8px to 24px over 800ms to 1500ms; blobs drift 20px to 60px over 20s.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts a panel 4px and brightens its fill by 10% in 400ms; active state returns it.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels calm, light and gently lifted out of the day.

avoid_when: The page needs dense data or many actions.
The brand is loud, technical or industrial.

modifiers.how: Use a paper ground, black ink and hairline rules; keep the light serif.
Add specular rims and capsule controls over the haze.
Replace haze with a white ground, black type and plain borders.

pack.why: A thin, round line that stays quiet on a pale, soft ground.

ground.why: Ethereal pages sit in a pale haze of soft light in pastel colour.
